question: Should maintainers sponsor the RFC’s shared localization contract and review this cumulative fourth series slice only after the first three foundation PRs establish the current baseline?
rationale: The branch introduces new cross-surface Gateway and plugin presentation contracts, and its protected maintainer label plus RFC dependency require repository-owner acceptance rather than an automated compatibility judgment.

options.title: Stage the RFC series
options.body: Review and land the preceding foundation slices first, then rebase this PR, remove the release-owned changelog entry, and review the resulting focused contract diff.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Split command/plugin metadata and Gateway protocol work into separately owned PRs if maintainers do not want one shared localization contract.

recommendation.title: Stage the RFC series
recommendation.body: Review and land the preceding foundation slices first, then rebase this PR, remove the release-owned changelog entry, and review the resulting focused contract diff.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible RFC-linked author of the staged proposal; the appropriate accepting owner must be a repository maintainer not identifiable from the available read-only evidence.
